summary: Installed the three accepted PDFs and the reviewed canonical web edition of the Claude postconciliar Twenty-sixth Sunday in Ordinary Time, Year A, wired the publication, and ran every terminal publication-gate check in this tree; all five exit 0. Nothing was committed; only the web Markdown is staged. Before installing, `--phase artifacts --require-presentation --require-format --require-authority` exited 0, and all six accepted seals (research under proper-study-v3 at research-review 1, study, synthesis, homily, visual, web) were recomputed with scripts/_proper_study.py seal and each equals what its accepted result records; they were recomputed again after the audit entry was written, with the same result. `make install-doc DOC=<id> PROVIDER=claude` was run once per output with nothing suppressed (no -o, no -t, no touched timestamp, no dependency edit, no change to an accepted source or to the generation timestamp). Make retypeset nothing: it found all three build PDFs current, ran the tool, source and generation-metadata checks, and copied the bytes, and the build PDFs, logs and aux files keep their build-stage times. Each build and installed PDF hashes to its accepted value and cmp finds each pair identical: study 33 pp. cbdec17636a338b03f5dbbffaec2a0162724358d0a3b074bcb286aca988e8fb2, concise 12 pp. 106d21c0ac77cb1dfdd303f2e6ba224702fb24fc81d03823611f00ddad3b1261, homily 4 pp. 2e2391674df899ed5e86558609da28d1c63ffefa112cb765b1a495f105b24a7e. No hash differs, so no artifact defect is reported. build/web/claude/<leaf>.md was copied byte for byte to web/claude/<leaf>.md (131,592 bytes, f4803b29f75a2af149ea4af6a689b36a905504b37e5d138d15f5c939ae78c3a2, equal to research/web-artifact.json and the web-review seal) and staged; git ls-files --error-unmatch proves it tracked. Only that file was installed; no synthesis or homily web leaf exists. Three release records were created with `make add-publication ID=<output-id> CATALOG=library/novus-ordo-liturgy.md PROVIDER=claude STATUS=alpha` (none existed): schema 1, exact output id, that catalog, status alpha, authorization perpetual-public-repository-2026. In library/novus-ordo-liturgy.md only the Twenty-sixth Sunday row's Year A cell changed, from Planned to the Research, Synthesis and Homily PDFs and the web page in manifest label order, labelled 'Claude Research PDF', 'Claude Synthesis PDF', 'Claude Homily PDF' and 'Read Claude' because gpt is the primary provider and a non-primary provider's links standing alone in a cycle cell must name it; B and C cells and all other rows are untouched and no companion row was added. One canonical marker, claude:<leaf>, was added after the other Claude markers. tools/tpt document-library structure regenerated corpus.json: the only change is this leaf's new work and Claude edition (143->144 works, 197->198 documents, 227->230 issues, 6,311->6,344 pages). The release refresh was scoped to exactly the three paths check-release-bindings had named (ADOPT=1 ONLY=catalog, corpus.json, the web edition): five changes, 0 stale afterwards. make check-publication-inventories had refused the tree (leaf, its files and the Week XXVI owner's verified.md missing; three registry digests superseded by this production's research checkpoint); tools/source-inventory refresh rewrote the Claude inventory (55->56 publications, 1,414->1,451 files, nothing else moved), the new entry's categories were set from its 102 bindings and References (finding-aid, historical-primary, institutional-current, liturgical, magisterial for Nostra aetate 4, patristic, repository-internal, scholastic, scripture, secondary) and applied with classify, and the inventory was refreshed again after the audit entry was written. Gate checks run here, all exit 0: `--phase publication --require-presentation --require-format --require-authority`; make check-release-bindings; tools/tpt public-alpha check --provider claude --document <leaf> (scoped policy valid, 230 publications); tools/tpt document-library check --provider claude --document <leaf> && document-library structure --check; make check-web-editions-current; plus make check-publication-inventories. Two upstream defects are reported, not repaired; neither is in the publication gate, but both block deployment (make check-sources / check-deployment-sources fail): (1) tools/source-reader structure --check finds the tracked projection src/web/data/structure/sources drifted in 14 files, every one a source record the research checkpoint 6bb9fcd60 registered or extended (IGMR 2011, MR 2002, ICEL Antiphonary, OLM 1981, CSEL 22, PL 9/26/37, Venice Aquinas, USCCB 2026 calendar, Jerome In Danielem PL 25 and In Hiezechielem, the 27 Sept readings edition, index); `tools/source-reader structure` plus a bindings refresh scoped to those paths clears it. (2) tools/tpt source-family-migration check finds the ledger's pinned canonical_catalog_snapshot stale: it equals the pin at the seed commit and moves at 6bb9fcd60, and this stage touched no record it covers; re-pinning is the ledger review step (--accept-canonical-catalog after family review), not publication wiring. Installation facts, the completed-review table from the run's retained results, the classification reasoning and both defects are recorded in research/production-review.md (Install-publication). That audit carries no Generate-web entry; the web facts are cited from the retained generate-web result and receipt.
